title: Investigation A — agent-driven FS+HP loop (CatBoost) vs _147 answer key

acceptance_check_147.root_cause_of_original_fails: NOT data drift (depth-4/depth-6 reproduce _147 to 4dp -> identical data). _147's depth-8 iteration confounded depth 6->8 AND l2_leaf_reg 3.0->1.5 in one step, so its depth-8 (0.1652, overfit @48 trees) was at l2=1.5 while depth-4/6 used l2=3.0. The automated loop re-ran depth-8 with l2 held at 3.0 -> 0.16326 (marginally below depth-6; gap +0.0044, no overfit). Depth 6/8 are a within-noise plateau, not a 6-peaked inverted-U. invB (_149, XGBoost) independently found the same depth-8 optimum.
acceptance_check_147.resolution: answer key deconfounded (depth_curve[8] 0.1652->0.1633; depth_optimal:6 -> {6,8} plateau + depth-4 underfit arm; ceiling_brier_lo 0.1641->0.1632; hp_band_width_max 0.0020->0.0030; meaningful_improvement 0.0005->0.0010; monotone check references best-unconstrained not iter-0). _147 annotated with the l2-confound correction. Re-run -> PASS 9/0. Unit tests updated, 12/12 pass.
qualitative_findings_reproduced: HP ceiling (tiny ~0.003 spread across depth 4/6/8 x lr 0.02/0.05)
FS neutral-to-harmful (best model keeps full 279-feature pool)
